originalRequest: revert to old design while keeping other changes
subject: Interactive Learning’s admin interface at /admin.
scope: Restore the admin page’s appearance and arrangement from dee8793, immediately before redesign commit dbaa281. Preserve unrelated changes and current functional safeguards.
primaryGoal: Bring back the familiar admin design without undoing other work.
audience: CEOs and Head Moderators administering accounts.
offer: Existing account timeout, allowance reset, and role-management tools.
primaryAction: Select an account and perform an authorized administrative action.
creativeControl: Minimal. Faithfully restore the previous admin design, making only adjustments needed to preserve current functionality and accessibility.
requiredContent: Admin introduction: restore the shield icon, shared PageTitle, and existing account-controls description.
User timeouts: restore the original single card with search and user list beside account details, reason, duration, and timeout actions.
CEO controls: restore allowance resets on the left and the searchable user directory on the right, stacking responsively.
Operational states: retain access checks, restrictions, loading, validation, saving, success, and error feedback.
constraints: Use dee8793 as the visual restoration baseline, not as a replacement for the entire working tree.
Do not revert dbaa281 wholesale: it also contains backend, authentication, navigation, performance, configuration, and other unrelated changes.
Preserve authentication, role enforcement, CEO-only controls, self-role restrictions, timeout rules, pagination, and quota-reset confirmation.

Preserve functional improvements introduced during the redesign, including duplicate-submission guards, trimmed-reason validation, safe error messages, and account-specific feedback, within the restored layout.
Retain reliable native role selects, keyboard access, visible focus, readable labels, and responsive behavior.
Remove redesign-specific panel compositions, styling, and entrance/reveal behavior from the admin page; preserve unrelated application motion.
Do not introduce new sections, imagery, branding, dependencies, or administrative capabilities.
brandInputs: src/lib/brand.ts and public/brand/: preserve the Interactive Learning name and monochrome IL identity.
src/app/globals.css: existing blue primary #3c85f7, light background #f7f7f7, white cards, gray borders, and established dark-theme tokens.
src/app/layout.tsx: Inter is the shared brand typeface; preserve current font-loading changes. Instrument Serif retains its existing non-admin roles.
src/components/ui/page.tsx, card.tsx, button.tsx, and input.tsx: restore the previous admin use of shared typography, surfaces, spacing, and controls.
dee8793 admin components: original timeout card above the paired allowance-reset and directory cards.
Existing application sidebar and shell remain unchanged.
assumptions: “Old design” means the admin appearance immediately before dbaa281, rather than an older version of the entire application.
“Other changes” includes unrelated work bundled into the redesign commit and nonvisual improvements to admin behavior.
This targeted restoration supersedes the previous reference-led redesign and its motion requirements.
The historical implementation is the authoritative visual baseline; additional marketing sections or a new reference-driven composition would contradict the request.
The working tree was clean during inspection. This briefing made no implementation changes.
unresolved: No screenshot of the previous rendered admin page was supplied; its historical source establishes the restoration baseline.
